schemas.name: Merge PDF
schemas.description: Merge PDF files online for free. Add PDFs, arrange their order and combine them into one document in your browser. No signup or server upload.

mainEntity.name: How do I merge PDF files into one document?

acceptedAnswer.text: Select your PDFs, arrange the files in the list, click Merge PDFs and download the combined document. Pages are copied in the displayed file order.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the order before merging?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Reorder the files with drag and drop or the up and down buttons. These controls reorder whole files. Use Organize PDF to rearrange individual pages.

mainEntity.name: Is there a limit on the number of PDFs?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed file-count limit in the merger. The practical limit depends on your browser and available device memory. Try smaller batches if a large merge fails.

mainEntity.name: Will merging PDFs reduce the file size?

acceptedAnswer.text: Merging combines pages; it does not target a smaller file size. Check the output size separately if a form or email has an attachment limit.

mainEntity.name: Do my PDFs get uploaded anywhere?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. ToolShoppy merges PDFs locally in your browser. No account or server upload is required.
